Your viral Reels and engaging carousel posts attract audiences on Instagram. But what happens when you want to get this audience to visit your website? Whether you want them to read a new post, check out your new collection or sign up for an event, you need a seamless link-in-bio strategy to drive traffic from Instagram to your site.


With Instagram limiting clickable caption links exclusively to Meta One subscribers, your bio link serves as prime real estate. Even then, you have only five spots to add your URLs. That means constantly swapping links every time you post something with a different landing page.


[Link-in-bio](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/link-in-bio/) tools like SproutLink and Linktree save you the trouble with dynamic landing pages that lead to multiple destinations.


Which tool should you use? While Linktree pioneered the link-in-bio category, SproutLink integrates directly into your publishing workflow. This post compares the two options, so you can decide on the right fit for your brand.


## What is SproutLink?


[SproutLink](https://sproutsocial.com/features/link-in-bio/) is Sprout Social’s proprietary and customizable link-in-bio solution that turns your social traffic into website visits, leads and revenue. Designed for use across multiple platforms—including Instagram, TikTok and other major social networks—SproutLink allows you to create a branded, centralized landing page featuring custom call-to-action buttons, direct social profile links and an optional clickable replica of your Instagram grid.


Because SproutLink lives directly within the publishing workflow, you can attach destination URLs while scheduling new posts in Compose or add links to existing posts retroactively—streamlining your publishing and link management in one centralized place.


## What is Linktree?


Linktree is a standalone[link-in-bio tool](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/link-in-bio-instagram-tool/) that hosts all your URLs in a simple, list-style landing page. It supports broad, platform-agnostic use, letting you centralize link management across all your social media profiles, not just Instagram.


Available in free and paid tiers, Linktree offers ready-made templates and a straightforward interface that makes it a beginner-friendly option.


*Source:[Linktree](https://linktr.ee/s/templates)*


## SproutLink vs. Linktree: How they compare


Both SproutLink and Linktree offer the essentials to manage your bio links in one place. The key difference is that SproutLink is a feature integrated within a comprehensive social media management ecosystem, while Linktree is a dedicated link-in-bio tool that also features a built-in Social Planner for content scheduling.


This distinction drives the main differences in workflow and pricing.


SproutLink costs more because it’s part of a full social media management platform. This also means it comes with powerful tools to manage every aspect of your social media, including publishing and reporting. The feature integrates directly with the rest of your publishing workflow, meaning you can attach links *while* composing a new post in Sprout.


Meanwhile, Linktree is a popular tool for managing social media bio links and scheduling posts. It costs less to get started and comes with a free plan for basic links. It’s platform-agnostic, meaning you can use it to manage[links in bio for Facebook](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/facebook-link-in-bio-guide/) and TikTok, not just Instagram.


Linktree also features a[built-in Social Planner](https://linktr.ee/features/social-planner) on paid plans that allows you to schedule and auto-post content across your social platforms. You can even schedule links and posts to go live at the same time, giving you a hands-free workflow.


Ultimately, deciding between the two comes down to your specific use case.

- Comprehensive link performance data


**Best for** Brands and solopreneurs wanting to centralize their social media management workflow Individuals and creators needing a beginner-friendly tool just for managing bio links


## What do review sites say about SproutLink vs. Linktree?


The comparison chart above gives you a better sense of what each tool offers, but how do they measure up in actual performance? Here’s what real users have to say on different review sites:


### SproutLink vs. Linktree comparison on G2


- **Linktree:** 4.6/5 (96 reviews) *
- **Sprout Social:** 4.4/5 (6,884 reviews)


Although Sprout scores slightly lower than Linktree, review volume reveals a significant difference. This volume gap highlights a difference in scope, not just sentiment.[G2](https://www.g2.com/compare/linktree-vs-sprout-social) reviewers are rating the whole Sprout suite instead of *just* the link-in-bio feature.


#### *G2 company-size data*


- 83% of Linktree reviewers are small businesses vs. 44.6% for Sprout Social
- 11.7% of Linktree reviewers are mid-market companies vs. 38.0% for Sprout Social
- 5.3% of Linktree reviewers are enterprise companies vs. 17.5% for Sprout Social


This data reinforces that G2 reviewers are ***rating the whole Sprout suite*** , used across company sizes, rather than just a small-business tool.


**The comparison data in this article is based on G2 data from 10/21/2026, unless stated otherwise.*


### SproutLink vs. Linktree comparison on Capterra


- **Linktree:** 4.5/5 (108 reviews) **
- **Sprout Social:** 4.4/5 (609 reviews)


Linktree slightly outranks Sprout even on[Capterra](https://www.capterra.com/compare/tool/#products=229171-121447) , but the gap in review volume is evident. User satisfaction scores for Sprout Social reflect ratings for a wide range of social media management features, not just limited to links in bio.


**Note:** Linktree’s high “ease of use” score (4.6**) reflects doing one thing well, while Sprout Social’s rating (4.4**) reflects an entire platform’s worth of functionality that *includes* SproutLink.


***The comparison data in this article is based on Capterra data from 10/21/2026, unless stated otherwise.*


## Why Sprout Social is built for brands, not just links


While SproutLink holds up as a strong Linktree alternative, it’s no longer about which tool has better reviews. Instead, you need to think about whether you need a link-in-bio tool or a platform that includes one.


Sprout Social combines your link-in-bio management with every other aspect of your social media. That means you don’t *just* get[Instagram link-in-bio](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/instagram-link-in-bio/) features. You also get scheduling, publishing and reporting all in one place.


This saves you the trouble of stitching together a link tool with a separate scheduler and manually adding a new link to your custom landing page every time.


Choosing a full social media management platform doesn’t have to cost hundreds of dollars each month. With low-cost starter options like the[Sprout Essentials plan](https://sproutsocial.com/essentials-trial/) , you get access to SproutLink along with all the basic publishing, scheduling and reporting features. Starting at $79 per seat per month, the plan lets you:


- Connect up to five social media profiles.
- Plan and schedule your posts with AI-powered Optimal Send Time suggestions.
- Access high-quality insights with profile and post-level reporting.


This makes it a solid choice for brands outgrowing manual posting that need their bio link connected to a broader content and reporting workflow.


“Sprout Social is clearly designed with Social Media Managers in mind,” states[Alyssa R.](https://app.userevidence.com/assets/3330PLXT?source=research_library) , a social media manager for a mid-market non-profit organization.


“As a one-person social team, I need to maximize my productivity, and I rely on Sprout every day. Its features, such as SproutLink in bio, the ability to toggle a single post across multiple platforms and the AI Alt Text Generator, have helped me streamline my workflow.”


## How to choose between SproutLink and Linktree


Linktree is a link management tool that offers basic publishing and analytics features. SproutLink is a feature of a larger, more robust social media management platform. Both tools offer unique value depending on your needs.


With this in mind, here’s a quick guideline to help you make the right choice.


**Choose Linktree if:**


- **You need a straightforward, beginner-friendly tool for managing bio links.**


- You’re a solo creator needing basic scheduling and link management features.


- You want a standalone landing page that works across different social networks, including Facebook and[TikTok](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/tiktok-link-in-bio-guide/) .


**Choose SproutLink if:**


- **You need a bio link that fits into your publishing workflow.** Sprout offers comprehensive social media planning, publishing and scheduling features to centralize management—so choosing SproutLink removes a tool from your stack instead of adding one.
- **You want to manage your bio links and social channels in a single platform.** Even on Sprout’s entry-level Essential plan, which includes up to five social profiles, you can consolidate scheduling, engagement and bio links to eliminate tool sprawl and context-switching.
- **You want analytics that go beyond link clicks.** Sprout connects your link-in-bio traffic to holistic post- and profile-level performance across channels. This informs your[small business social media marketing](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-marketing-for-small-business/) efforts to prioritize what resonates.


## Choose the platform, not just the link


As the tool that pioneered bio links, Linktree continues to dominate the link-in-bio landscape. But with alternatives like SproutLink that integrate with your publishing workflow, management becomes effortless without the need to constantly switch platforms.


The choice comes down to whether you need a standalone tool or a comprehensive platform to manage your entire social strategy, bio links included.


Still not sure if SproutLink is the right choice for you?[Start your free trial](https://sproutsocial.com/essentials-trial/) of Sprout Essentials and get SproutLink, scheduling and reporting in one place.

## FAQs about SproutLink


Is SproutLink free?


SproutLink is not free, but it’s included with every Sprout Social plan, which starts at $79 per month.


Does SproutLink work on platforms other than Instagram?


No, SproutLink only works for Instagram profiles at this time.


Can I switch from Linktree to SproutLink?


Yes, you can switch from Linktree to SproutLink when you sign up for any of the Sprout Social plans.


Do I need a specific Sprout Social plan to use SproutLink?


No, you don’t need a specific Sprout Social plan to use SproutLink. The feature is available across every plan level.


How does SproutLink track clicks?


SproutLink tracks clicks by monitoring user engagement on your custom SproutLink landing page. It attributes link clicks to specific posts, tracks post clicks and daily page views and updates metrics every hour.
